provenance.method: Current nidirect Personal Independence Payment information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the Northern Ireland route without making an individual entitlement claim.

name: nidirect — Personal Independence Payment (Northern Ireland)
description: Official Northern Ireland information about Personal Independence Payment (PIP), including current eligibility, amounts and review information.
intended_use: Find the Northern Ireland PIP route when a long-term health condition or disability causes difficulty with everyday tasks or getting around.
audience_or_context: People living in Northern Ireland who may need to inspect the current PIP rules and application route.
limitations: This listing does not determine eligibility or award level.
England and Wales use the GOV.UK PIP route; Scotland uses Adult Disability Payment.
Benefit rules and rates can change.
cost_or_access_notes: Official information is publicly accessible through nidirect.
conflicts_of_interest: nidirect is a first-party Northern Ireland public-service information source; ND Oracle records the route without assessing individual entitlement.
